lines.gloss: What's up? I just got back from work.

lines.text: گلتلك ماكو وقت، لازم نطلع هسه.

lines.text: الچاي حار هواية، انطيني شوية مي بارد.
lines.gloss: The tea is very hot, give me a little cold water.
Tomorrow morning we sit with you at the café.
